application_method: Step 1: choose a field of study, complete the online application form at the official UwayApply link, and pay the application fee (use a Windows-based computer)
Step 2: upload required documents, including two recommendation letters sent to referees via Google Forms (link released only after fee payment)
Step 3: monitor email regularly for notifications or interviews from the admission team or department
Step 4: respond to the admission offer by the specified date after results are sent by email
Step 5: submit enrolment documents by post and pay the 680,000 won matriculation fee by the enrolment deadline
Step 6: submit apostilled or embassy-authenticated original degree certificate and transcript within 10 days after enrolment (CSSD report for Chinese graduates)
Step 7: apply for a student visa with the Certificate of Admission
official.application_route: Apply online through GIST's official UwayApply application during a published admission window; the government-sponsored scholarship is granted automatically on admission, with no separate scholarship application.
official.citizenship_residency: Published for international graduate applicants; the living-expense allowance applies to international students, while the master's and doctoral government-scholarship allowances apply to students designated government scholarship students.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - all international students receive the monthly stipends, 60% National Health Insurance support and one-way airfare reimbursement.
official.duration: Master's scholarship benefit for a maximum of 4 enrolled semesters; doctoral teaching-assistant benefit and tuition support for a maximum of 8 enrolled semesters.
official.description: GIST supports all enrolled students with 'Tuition fully supported: 3,607,000 won per semester' and provides international students a government-sponsored package: a student allowance of 140,000 won per month for M.S. and 295,000 won per month for Ph.D. students, a meal allowance of nearly 100,000 won per month and an international student allowance of 120,000 won per month, plus 60% National Health Insurance support and one-way airfare reimbursement. The award follows admission to GIST - there is no separate scholarship application - and benefits are deposited into the student's bank account on the 1st of each month on the department's monthly request.
official.program_type: Government-funded graduate scholarship attached automatically to GIST admission
official.english_requirement: Official score required: TOEFL iBT 80, TOEFL PBT 550, IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEIC 750 or NEW TEPS 285, taken within two years of the application deadline. Exemption with prior GIST approval for native-born citizens of Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or the USA and for holders of bachelor or advanced degrees from universities in those countries. Conditional admission is possible with a Certificate of English Language Proficiency (medium of instruction was English) issued by the president or dean of the last school, but official scores must be submitted within 6 months of admission or the student is removed from the school register.

applicant_utility.summary: GIST folds its government-sponsored package into admission itself: merit in the application review is what wins the scholarship, so competition happens at the admission stage rather than in a separate funding decision. Budget around a 680,000 won one-time matriculation fee, dormitory fees plus separate utilities, and the roughly 40% of national health insurance not covered. If you are relying on English-medium instruction instead of a test score, treat the conditional-admission route as a hard six-month clock from the date of admission, not from graduation.
applicant_utility.best_fit: STEM-focused Master's and PhD applicants who want full tuition plus a monthly stipend without writing a separate scholarship application.
application_readiness_checklist: Book TOEFL iBT (80+) or Academic IELTS (6.5+) early enough that the score date falls within two years of the application deadline
Line up two referees (faculty members or supervisors) who will submit via the Google Forms link, which only activates after you pay the application fee
Start the apostille or Korean-embassy authentication of your degree certificate and transcripts now, since unverified certificates cancel admission after enrolment
Prepare the Windows-only online form, passport copy, and (if needed) a department-chair recommendation letter for the matriculation fee waiver
common_rejection_risks: Missing the matriculation fee or enrolment document deadline - the admission offer is revoked, not deferred
Losing stipend eligibility by dropping below 9 credits in a semester, which suspends the student and meal allowances
Falling under GPA 3.0/4.5, which ends the 120,000 won monthly international student allowance
Conditional-admission students failing to lodge official test results within 6 months of admission and being struck from the register
Recommendation letters that never arrive because referees were registered late or missed the deadline
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: 680,000 won one-time matriculation fee (waivable on hardship), dormitory or married-student apartment monthly fees with deposits and separately charged utilities plus any room refurbishment costs, the share of national health insurance not supported, and personal travel and living expenses.
document_audit: Degree certificate and transcripts need apostille or Korean embassy/consular authentication - uncertified copies cancel admission after enrolment, so certify early
Chinese university graduates must use the CSSD (chsi.com.cn) verification report instead of standard certificates
Recommendation letters arrive only through Google Forms; emailed or uploaded PDFs from referees are not received
If the transcript shows no grading scale, add a supplementary document describing the university's grading system
alerts: The Spring 2027 application window closed on 7 October 2026; the next window opens 9 March 2027 and closes 8 April 2027 (17:00 KST), so waiting until spring 2027 to prepare risks the round
Benefits pause after a leave of absence or overseas dispatch and during disciplinary probation - plan research placements carefully
Enrolled students receive deposits on the 1st of each month via a departmental request, so stipend timing depends on the department acting promptly
GIST recommends an English or Korean test score regardless of admission, because Korean immigration may require one for the visa
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the Windows-compatible UwayApply form, pay the fee, upload documents and trigger the referee Google Forms; document review and evaluation decide admission, after which the scholarship registers itself and pays out monthly.

Graduates (or expected graduates) of universities in English-native countries are exempt; graduates of universities in English-official-language countries may submit a certificate proving completion of courses in English.

applicant_utility.summary: DGIST pays for the degree to come to you: once admitted to a listed department, the Government Scholarship registers itself, so the real work is convincing the department through document screening and an online interview. Map your intended department against the published list before anything else - five departments (including the Technology and Innovation Management track) sit under the separate DGIST-funded scholarship instead. Treat the statement of purpose as the core document: several departments require named research fields, preferred labs or subjects, and two require you to have already email contact with faculty.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International applicants to DGIST's listed science, engineering and interdisciplinary STEM departments who want full tuition plus a guaranteed stipend without a separate scholarship application.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your target department appears on the Government Scholarship list, then email the relevant faculty member early if you target Interdisciplinary Engineering or a Robotics and Mechatronics PhD

Draft the statement of purpose to the published word limits (300 English words per research/vision theme) and embed the department-specific items: up to three research fields for EECS, two preferred subjects for Energy Science and Engineering, a preferred lab for Robotics PhD
Have degree certificates and transcripts apostilled or Korean-embassy notarised, then merge Type B and C into one English PDF under 8 MB - a missing item means the application is not evaluated
Check whether your department mandates English proof: New Biology and the AIMS track require a report within four years; otherwise it is optional with no minimum score
common_rejection_risks: Applying to more than one department in the same intake, which is not permitted
Incomplete uploads: DGIST states applications with missing required documents will not be considered for evaluation
Un-apostilled or untranslated academic documents, especially for applicants who studied abroad
Not graduating from the previous school by the enrolment date, which cancels admission automatically
Any false information in submitted documents, which cancels admission outright
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Application fee (amount set per round, published with the online application link), Biseul Village housing at 170,000-290,000 KRW per month plus utilities, and day-to-day living costs above the minimum stipend before research-performance incentives.
document_audit: Type B documents must be in English with apostille or Korean-embassy notarisation from the university's country - plain scans are not enough
All Type B and C documents must be one merged PDF smaller than 8 MB; oversized or split uploads break the submission
Certificate of employment and recommendation letter are compulsory only for the General Scholarship (currently employed) track - do not submit them expecting an advantage on the Government track
Chinese-study candidates need Ministry of Education documents from chsi.com.cn; submitted documents are never returned, so keep certified copies
Dual registration with another institution is strictly prohibited and means expulsion if discovered
